question:
Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?

[SSC CGL 2023]
options: Bryophyta - Moss
Angiosperms - Rose
Pteridophyta - Cycas
Gymnosperms - Pinus
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Pteridophyta - Cycas

Explanation:
Pteridophyta is a group of plants that includes ferns and horsetails. These are seedless vascular plants. Cycas, on the other hand, is a gymnosperm, representing naked-seeded plants, not a pteridophyte. Gymnosperms produce seeds but do not form flowers. Hence, the pair 'Pteridophyta - Cycas' is incorrectly matched.

Other pairs are correctly matched:
- Bryophyta - Moss: These are non-vascular plants.
- Angiosperms - Rose: These are flowering plants where seeds develop inside fruits.
- Gymnosperms - Pinus: These are naked-seeded plants where seeds are produced in cones.

Extra Facts:
- Pteridophytes are among the oldest vascular plants and played a crucial role in the Carboniferous period.
- Cycas, also called 'sago palm,' is an ancient gymnosperm that has existed since the age of dinosaurs.
- Angiosperms are the most diverse group of plants, including fruits, vegetables, grains, and flowers.

☛ Examples of Angiosperms? → Rose, Wheat
☛ Examples of Gymnosperms? → Pinus, Cycas
☛ Examples of Pteridophyta? → Fern, Horsetail
☛ Which plant group has seeds but no flowers? → Gymnosperms
question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा युग्म, गलत रूप से सुमेलित है?

[SSC CGL 2023]
options_hi: ब्रायोफाइटा - मॉस
एंजियोस्पर्म - गुलाब
टेरिडोफाइटा - साइकस
जिम्नोस्पर्म - पाइनस
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है टेरिडोफाइटा - साइकस

Explanation:
टेरिडोफाइटा (Pteridophyta) पौधों का एक समूह है जिसमें फर्न (fern) और हॉर्सटेल (horsetail) जैसे पौधे आते हैं। ये बीज रहित संवहनी पौधे (seedless vascular plants) होते हैं। साइकस (Cycas) एक जिम्नोस्पर्म (Gymnosperm) है, जो नग्नबीजी पौधों का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है, न कि टेरिडोफाइट का। जिम्नोस्पर्म में बीज होते हैं, लेकिन ये फूल नहीं बनाते। इसलिए, 'टेरिडोफाइटा - साइकस' का युग्म गलत है।

अन्य युग्म सही हैं:
- ब्रायोफाइटा - मॉस (Bryophyta - Moss): ये गैर-संवहनी पौधे (non-vascular plants) हैं।
- एंजियोस्पर्म - गुलाब (Angiosperms - Rose): ये फूल वाले पौधे हैं जिनमें बीज फल के अंदर बनते हैं।
- जिम्नोस्पर्म - पाइनस (Gymnosperms - Pinus): ये नग्नबीजी पौधे हैं जिनमें बीज शंकु (cones) में होते हैं।

Extra Facts:
- टेरिडोफाइट्स पृथ्वी पर सबसे पुराने संवहनी पौधों में से हैं और इन्होंने कोयला युग (Carboniferous period) में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई थी।
- साइकस को 'सागौन पाम' भी कहा जाता है और यह एक प्राचीन जिम्नोस्पर्म है जो डायनासोर के युग से मौजूद है।
- एंजियोस्पर्म पृथ्वी पर सबसे विविध पौधे हैं और इनमें फल, सब्जियां, अनाज और फूल शामिल हैं।

question:
Plants are divided into groups. Which of the following is NOT one of them?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Thallophytes
Arthropoda
Gymnosperms
Angiosperms
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Arthropoda

Explanation:
Plants are primarily divided into four groups: Thallophytes (e.g., algae), Bryophytes (e.g., mosses), Pteridophytes (e.g., ferns), and Spermatophytes (seed-bearing plants). Spermatophytes are further divided into Gymnosperms (naked seeds) and Angiosperms (flowering plants). Arthropoda is an animal phylum that includes insects, spiders, and crustaceans, not plants. It belongs to a different classification category in biology.

Extra Facts:
In plant classification, Thallophytes are the simplest plants lacking roots, stems, and leaves. Gymnosperms have seeds not enclosed in fruits, e.g., pine and cycads. Angiosperms are flowering plants with seeds enclosed in fruits. Arthropoda is the largest animal phylum, comprising over 80% of known animal species, including insects and crabs.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams
☛ Who is considered the father of plant classification? → Carolus Linnaeus
☛ Which group do ferns belong to? → Pteridophytes
☛ Example of a gymnosperm plant? → Pine
☛ Example of an angiosperm plant? → Mango
☛ Which phylum do insects belong to? → Arthropoda

पादपों को समूहों में विभाजित किया जाता है। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा उनमें से एक नहीं है?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options_hi: थैलोफाइटा
आर्थ्रोपोडा
जिम्नोस्पर्म
एंजियोस्पर्म
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है आर्थ्रोपोडा

Explanation:
पादपों को मुख्य रूप से चार समूहों में विभाजित किया जाता है: थैलोफाइटा (जैसे शैवाल), ब्रायोफाइटा (जैसे मॉस), टेरिडोफाइटा (जैसे फर्न), और स्पर्मेटोफाइटा (बीज वाले पौधे)। स्पर्मेटोफाइटा को आगे जिम्नोस्पर्म (नग्नबीजी) और एंजियोस्पर्म (आवृतबीजी) में विभाजित किया जाता है। आर्थ्रोपोडा एक जंतु समूह है, जिसमें कीट, मकड़ी और क्रस्टेशियन शामिल हैं, न कि पादप। यह जीव विज्ञान में वर्गीकरण की एक अलग श्रेणी है।

Extra Facts:
पादप वर्गीकरण में, थैलोफाइटा सबसे सरल पौधे हैं, जिनमें जड़, तना और पत्तियों का अभाव होता है। जिम्नोस्पर्म में बीज फलों के अंदर नहीं होते, जैसे पाइन और साइकस। एंजियोस्पर्म फूल वाले पौधे हैं, जिनके बीज फलों के अंदर होते हैं। आर्थ्रोपोडा जंतु संघ है, जो जीवों का सबसे बड़ा समूह है, जिसमें 80% से अधिक ज्ञात जंतु प्रजातियाँ शामिल हैं।

question:
Organisms belonging to the phylum ______ are also called ‘flatworms’.

[SSC CGL 2021]
options: Platyhelminthes
Ctenophora
Porifera
Cnidaria
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Platyhelminthes

Explanation:
Organisms belonging to the phylum Platyhelminthes are called 'flatworms' because their bodies are dorsoventrally flattened. Most of them are parasitic, such as tapeworms (Taenia) and liver flukes (Fasciola), but some are free-living, like Planaria. They are triploblastic (having three germ layers) but lack a true coelom (acoelomate). Their digestive system is incomplete, with only a single opening. They exhibit bilateral symmetry and have a simple nervous system with a rudimentary brain (ganglia) and nerve cords.

Extra Facts:
Flatworms are known for their high regenerative capacity; for example, Planaria can regenerate an entire organism from a small body fragment. Some species have eye spots that detect light but lack complex sensory organs. Parasitic flatworms like Schistosoma cause diseases such as schistosomiasis. They lack respiratory and circulatory systems, relying on diffusion for gas exchange. The phylum includes three main classes: Turbellaria (free-living), Trematoda (flukes), and Cestoda (tapeworms).

Important one-liners for upcoming exams
☛ Which phylum includes flatworms? → Platyhelminthes
☛ Planaria belongs to which phylum? → Platyhelminthes
☛ What type of body symmetry do flatworms exhibit? → Bilateral symmetry
☛ Which phylum contains acoelomate, triploblastic organisms? → Platyhelminthes
☛ Name a parasitic flatworm. → Tapeworm (Taenia)
question_hi:
______संघ से संबंधित जीवों को चपटाकृमि 'फ्लैटवर्म' भी कहा जाता है।

[SSC CGL 2021]
options_hi: प्लेटिहेल्मिन्थेस (Platyhelminthes)
केटेनोफोरा(Ctenophora)
पोरिफेरा (Porifera)
निडारिया (Cnidaria)
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है प्लेटिहेल्मिन्थेस (Platyhelminthes)

Explanation:
प्लेटिहेल्मिन्थेस संघ के जीवों को चपटाकृमि या 'फ्लैटवर्म' कहा जाता है क्योंकि इनका शरीर चपटा (dorsoventrally flattened) होता है। ये ज्यादातर परजीवी (parasitic) होते हैं, जैसे टैपवर्म (tapeworm) और लिवर फ्लूक (liver fluke), लेकिन कुछ मुक्तजीवी (free-living) भी होते हैं, जैसे प्लेनेरिया (Planaria)। इनमें त्रिस्तरीय कोशिका भित्ति (triploblastic) पाई जाती है, लेकिन इनमें सही अंग प्रणाली (organ system) और देहगुहा (coelom) नहीं होती। ये अंडाकार (acoelomate) होते हैं। इनमें पाचन तंत्र (digestive system) अधूरा होता है, जिसमें केवल एक ही छिद्र (single opening) होता है।

Extra Facts:
प्लेटिहेल्मिन्थेस संघ के जीवों में अधिकांश परजीवी होते हैं जो मनुष्य और अन्य जानवरों में रोग पैदा कर सकते हैं। उदाहरण के लिए, टैपवर्म (Taenia solium) मनुष्य की आंत में पाया जाता है और पोर्क टेपवर्म संक्रमण का कारण बनता है। इनमें उच्च पुनर्जनन क्षमता (regeneration capacity) पाई जाती है, जिसके कारण प्लेनेरिया जैसे जीव अपने शरीर के टुकड़ों से पूर्ण जीव बना सकते हैं। इनमें संवेदी अंग (sensory organs) कम विकसित होते हैं, लेकिन कुछ प्रजातियों में आंख के धब्बे (eye spots) पाए जाते हैं जो प्रकाश का पता लगाने में मदद करते हैं।

Important one-liners for upcoming exams

question:
Corals are marine invertebrates within the class Anthozoa of phylum ___________.

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Arthropoda
Mollusca
Cnidaria
Nematoda
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Cnidaria

Explanation:
Corals are marine invertebrates belonging to the class 'Anthozoa', which is part of the phylum 'Cnidaria'. The phylum Cnidaria also includes jellyfish, hydra, and sea anemones. These organisms possess specialized cells called 'cnidocytes', which are used for capturing prey and defense. Corals are known for building coral reefs, which are vital for marine ecosystems.

Extra Facts:
Cnidarians are diploblastic, meaning they have only two germ layers: ectoderm and endoderm. They have a central gastrovascular cavity that serves both digestive and circulatory functions. Corals form a symbiotic relationship with photosynthetic algae called zooxanthellae, which provide them with nutrients. Coral reefs act as nurseries for marine biodiversity and protect coastlines from erosion.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams
☛ Which specialized cells are found in Cnidarians? → Cnidocytes
☛ What builds coral reefs? → Corals
☛ How many germ layers do Cnidarians have? → Two (diploblastic)
☛ With whom do corals form a symbiotic relationship? → Zooxanthellae
☛ Which phylum includes jellyfish and hydra? → Cnidaria
question_hi:
प्रवाल ___________ वर्ग के एन्थोजोआ वर्ग के भीतर समुद्री अकशेरूकीय हैं

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options_hi: आर्थ्रोपोड़ा
मोलस्का
निडारिया
निमेटोडा
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है निडारिया

Explanation:
प्रवाल (Corals) समुद्री अकशेरूकीय (marine invertebrates) हैं जो 'एन्थोजोआ' (Anthozoa) वर्ग के अंतर्गत आते हैं। यह वर्ग 'निडारिया' (Cnidaria) संघ (phylum) का हिस्सा है। निडारिया संघ में जेलीफिश, हाइड्रा और समुद्री एनीमोन भी शामिल हैं। इन जीवों में 'निडोसाइट्स' (cnidocytes) नामक विशेष कोशिकाएं पाई जाती हैं, जिनका उपयोग शिकार को पकड़ने और बचाव के लिए किया जाता है। प्रवाल प्रवाल भित्तियों (coral reefs) का निर्माण करते हैं, जो समुद्री पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र के लिए अत्यंत महत्वपूर्ण हैं।

Extra Facts:
निडारिया संघ के जीव द्विस्तरीय (diploblastic) होते हैं, यानी इनमें केवल एक्टोडर्म (ectoderm) और एंडोडर्म (endoderm) परतें होती हैं। इनमें एक केंद्रीय गुहा (gastrovascular cavity) होती है जो पाचन और वितरण का कार्य करती है। प्रवाल प्रकाश संश्लेषण (photosynthesis) करने वाले सहजीवी शैवाल (symbiotic algae) ज़ोक्सांथेली (zooxanthellae) के साथ सहजीवन (symbiosis) करते हैं, जो उन्हें पोषण प्रदान करते हैं। प्रवाल भित्तियाँ समुद्री जैव विविधता के लिए नर्सरी का काम करती हैं।

question:
Which of the following plants belong to gymnosperms?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Moss
Deodar
Chara
Marsilea
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Deodar

Explanation:
Gymnosperms are seed-producing plants with 'naked seeds,' meaning their seeds are not enclosed within an ovary or fruit. They typically include coniferous plants like Deodar (Cedrus deodara), Pine, and Spruce. Deodar is a coniferous tree belonging to the gymnosperm group. Other options like Moss belong to Bryophytes, Chara is an alga, and Marsilea is a fern (Pteridophyte).

Extra Facts:
Gymnosperms are mostly perennial, woody, and evergreen. They rely on wind for pollination and are commonly found in cold and temperate regions. Their seeds lack an ovary wall, hence called 'naked seeds.' They have economic importance as they provide timber, resin, and cellulose for paper production. Examples include Pine, Cycas, and Ginkgo.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams
☛ Where are the seeds of gymnosperms found? → In cones
☛ Which plant is not an angiosperm? → Pine
☛ To which group do ferns belong? → Pteridophytes
☛ How does pollination occur in gymnosperms? → By wind
☛ Cycas belongs to which group? → Gymnosperms
question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा पौधा जिम्नोस्पर्म से संबंधित है?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options_hi: मॉस
देवदार
चारा
मार्सिलिया
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है देवदार

Explanation:
जिम्नोस्पर्म (Gymnosperms) नग्नबीजी पौधे होते हैं, जिनके बीज फलों के अंदर नहीं बल्कि खुले हुए होते हैं। इनमें आमतौर पर शंकुधारी पौधे (Conifers) शामिल होते हैं, जैसे देवदार (Deodar), चीड़, स्प्रूस आदि। देवदार (Cedrus deodara) एक शंकुधारी पौधा है जो जिम्नोस्पर्म समूह से संबंधित है। अन्य विकल्प जैसे मॉस (Moss) ब्रायोफाइट्स समूह से, चारा (Chara) शैवाल समूह से और मार्सिलिया (Marsilea) फर्न समूह से संबंधित हैं।

Extra Facts:
जिम्नोस्पर्म पौधे प्रायः बहुवर्षीय, लकड़ीदार और सदाबहार होते हैं। इनमें परागण हवा के माध्यम से होता है। ये पौधे मुख्यतः ठंडे और समशीतोष्ण क्षेत्रों में पाए जाते हैं। जिम्नोस्पर्म्स के बीजों में अंडाशय की दीवार नहीं होती, इसलिए इन्हें 'नग्नबीजी' कहा जाता है। इनका आर्थिक महत्व भी है, क्योंकि इनसे लकड़ी, रेजिन, और कागज बनाने के लिए सेलूलोज़ प्राप्त होता है।

question:
Identify a spiral-shaped bacteria

[SSC CGL 2024]
options: Bacillus
Spirillum
Coccus
Vibrio
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Spirillum

Explanation:
Bacteria are classified based on their shapes. Spirillum is a spiral-shaped (helical) bacteria, which appears as a long, twisted structure. It is distinct from other bacteria such as Bacillus (rod-shaped), Coccus (spherical), and Vibrio (comma-shaped). The spiral shape of Spirillum bacteria helps them move easily in liquid media. These bacteria are often found in aquatic environments, and some species can cause diseases in humans.

Extra Facts:
The shape of bacteria plays a crucial role in their classification. Bacillus (rod-shaped) bacteria, such as Bacillus anthracis, cause anthrax. Coccus (spherical) bacteria, like Staphylococcus aureus, can cause skin infections. Vibrio (comma-shaped) bacteria, such as Vibrio cholerae, cause cholera. An example of Spirillum bacteria is Spirillum minus, which can cause rat-bite fever.

question:
Which of the following is a common type of Bryophyta?

[SSC CHSL 2022]
options: Cladophora
Marsilea
Marchantia
Monocot
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Marchantia

Explanation:
Bryophyta is a group of plants also known as the 'amphibians of the plant kingdom' because they grow in moist places. They lack vascular tissues. Marchantia is a common type of Bryophyta that belongs to liverworts. It grows on damp soil, rocks, and tree bark. It has a thallus body that looks like a leaf. Among the other options, Cladophora is a green alga, Marsilea is a fern, and Monocot is a class of angiosperms.

Extra Facts:
Bryophyta includes mosses, liverworts, and hornworts. These plants reproduce using spores and do not have roots; instead, they have rhizoids that anchor the plant to the surface. Bryophytes are ecologically important as they prevent soil erosion and retain moisture. Marchantia is also used in traditional medicine.

question:
What is the scientific name of the fruit mango?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Magna Indica
Mangus Indica
Mangifera Indica
Mangus Indicus
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Mangifera Indica

Explanation:
The scientific name of mango is Mangifera Indica. It belongs to the Anacardiaceae family. Mango is called the 'King of Fruits' and is the national fruit of India. In scientific naming, the first word represents the genus, and the second word represents the species. According to the Binomial Nomenclature system developed by Carl Linnaeus, mango was given this name. Mango is believed to have originated in the Indian subcontinent and is now cultivated worldwide.

Extra Facts:
1. There are over 1000 varieties of mango, with 'Alphonso', 'Dasheri', 'Langra', and 'Chausa' being the most popular.
2. A mango tree can live up to 300 years on average.
3. Mangoes are rich in Vitamin C, Vitamin A, fiber, and antioxidants.
4. India is the largest producer of mangoes globally, contributing nearly 50% of the world's production.

question:
Which of the following is not a subgroup of plant kingdom?

[SSC CHSL 2022]
options: Thallophyta
Angiosperms
Pteridophyta
Hemichordata
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Hemichordata

Explanation:
The Plant Kingdom is primarily divided into five subgroups: Thallophyta, Bryophyta, Pteridophyta, Gymnosperms, and Angiosperms. Thallophyta includes algae, which lack roots, stems, and leaves. Pteridophyta consists of ferns and related plants that possess vascular tissues. Angiosperms are flowering plants that develop seeds inside fruits. Hemichordata is an animal group that includes marine organisms like Balanoglossus and is not part of the Plant Kingdom.

Extra Facts:
The classification of the Plant Kingdom is based on structure, reproduction methods, and the presence of vascular tissues. Bryophyta is called the 'Amphibians of the Plant Kingdom' because they depend on both water and land. Gymnosperms are naked-seeded plants, such as Pine and Deodar. The study of the Plant Kingdom falls under Botany, while Hemichordata is part of Zoology.

question:
Which among the following are called the amphibians of the plant kingdom?

[SSC MTS 2022]
options: Gymnosperm
Bryophyte
Thallophyte
Angiosperm
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Bryophyte

Explanation:
Bryophytes are called the 'amphibians of the plant kingdom' because they can survive in both aquatic and terrestrial environments but require water for reproduction. These plants lack true roots, stems, and leaves, and do not have vascular tissues like xylem and phloem, which limits their size and habitat to moist areas. Their life cycle alternates between two stages – the gametophyte (dominant stage) and sporophyte. Examples include mosses and liverworts.

Extra Facts:
Bryophytes play a crucial role in ecosystems by preventing soil erosion, retaining moisture, and contributing to the carbon cycle. They are used in medicine, fuel, and decoration. Bryophytes are among the oldest land plants and are considered a 'key to plant evolution'.

question:
Which among the following is an example of Angiosperm in Plant Kingdom?

[SSC MTS 2022]
options: Pinus
Chara
Tomato
Funaria
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Tomato

Explanation:
Angiosperms are plants that have seeds enclosed within a fruit. These plants produce flowers and their ovules are enclosed in an ovary. Tomato is an angiosperm because it produces flowers and its seeds are found inside the fruit. On the other hand, Pinus is a gymnosperm where seeds are naked, Chara is an algae, and Funaria is a bryophyte which belongs to the moss group.

Extra Facts:
Angiosperms are the most diverse and abundant group of plants on Earth. They are divided into two main classes: Monocots and Dicots. Monocots include plants like wheat, corn, and grass, while dicots include plants like tomato, mango, and apple. Angiosperms are crucial for humans as they are the primary source of our food.

solution:

Extra Facts:
Coelenterata organisms have only one opening (mouth/anus) called coelenteron. Arthropoda is the largest phylum in the animal kingdom including insects, spiders, crabs etc. Mammals possess hair, mammary glands and thermoregulation ability. Mollusca organisms have muscular foot and mantle like clams, snails, octopus etc.

question:
Who is the father of binomial nomenclature of all species of living things?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Charles Darwin
James Watson
Louis Pasteur
Carolus Linnaeus
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Carolus Linnaeus

Explanation:
Binomial Nomenclature is a system of naming species of living organisms with two names: Genus and Species. This system was introduced by Carolus Linnaeus in his book 'Species Plantarum' (1753). Linnaeus is also known as the 'Father of Taxonomy' for his contributions to the systematic classification of organisms. His method provided a universal framework still used today to name and categorize species.

Extra Facts:
1. Taxonomic Hierarchy: Linnaeus classified organisms into Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, and Species.
2. Scientific Name of Humans: Linnaeus named humans Homo sapiens.
3. Naming Codes (ICBN & ICZN): Separate rules govern plant and animal nomenclature under ICBN (International Code of Botanical Nomenclature) and ICZN (International Code of Zoological Nomenclature).

☛ What is the scientific name of humans? → Homo sapiens
☛ How many names are used in binomial nomenclature? → Two (Genus & Species)
☛ Which book did Linnaeus write on species classification? → Species Plantarum

solution_hi:

Explanation:
द्विपद नामकरण (Binomial Nomenclature) जीवों की प्रजातियों को वैज्ञानिक नाम देने की एक प्रणाली है, जिसमें दो नाम होते हैं - जीनस (Genus) और प्रजाति (Species)। इस प्रणाली को कैरोलस लिनिअस (Carolus Linnaeus) ने 1753 में अपनी पुस्तक 'स्पीशीज प्लांटेरम' (Species Plantarum) में प्रस्तुत किया था। लिनिअस को 'वर्गीकरण विज्ञान का जनक' (Father of Taxonomy) भी कहा जाता है। उन्होंने जीवों को व्यवस्थित रूप से वर्गीकृत करने के लिए एक सार्वभौमिक प्रणाली विकसित की, जिसका उपयोग आज भी किया जाता है।

Extra Facts:
1. वर्गीकरण की पदानुक्रम (Taxonomic Hierarchy): लिनिअस ने जीवों को किंगडम, फाइलम, क्लास, ऑर्डर, फैमिली, जीनस और स्पीशीज में वर्गीकृत किया।
2. मानव का वैज्ञानिक नाम: लिनिअस ने मनुष्य को होमो सेपियन्स (Homo sapiens) नाम दिया।

question:
In the animal kingdom, which of the following phyla includes animals with a segmented body?

[SSC MTS 2024]
options: Chordata
Arthropoda
Annelida
Mollusca
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Annelida

Explanation:
The phylum Annelida includes animals with a segmented body. These animals have a body divided into repeated segments called metameres, which are visibly separated from each other. Examples include earthworms, leeches, and marine annelids. This segmentation aids in mobility and specialization of body parts. While Arthropoda also exhibits segmentation, the question specifically refers to Annelida as it is their defining characteristic.

Extra Facts:
Annelids possess a well-developed digestive system, closed circulatory system, and nervous system. Some annelids, like earthworms, play a crucial role in enhancing soil fertility. They are also called 'ringed worms' due to their segmented appearance. Their skin contains smooth muscles and a cuticle that helps retain moisture. Annelids are mostly found in moist environments, including freshwater, marine habitats, and terrestrial soils.

question:
Which of the following is the red algae?

[SSC CGL 2023]
options: Rhodophyceae
Chlorophyceae
Liverwort
Phaeophyceae
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Rhodophyceae

Explanation:
Rhodophyceae is the scientific name for red algae. This algae is found in marine environments and contains a pigment called 'phycoerythrin' which gives it a red color. It is capable of absorbing light for photosynthesis even in deep water. Red algae are used to produce 'agar', which is important in biological laboratories and the food industry. Among the other options, Chlorophyceae are green algae, Phaeophyceae are brown algae, and Liverwort belongs to the Bryophytes group.

Extra Facts:
Red algae play a crucial role in marine ecosystems. They assist in the formation of coral reefs. Their cell walls are composed of 'cellulose' and 'pectin'. They are also used as food and medicine, such as 'nori', which is used in making sushi. The fossil record of red algae dates back to approximately 1.2 billion years, indicating their ancient origin.

question:
______ are the amphibians of the plant kingdom.

[SSC CHSL 2023]
options: Gymnosperm
Pteridophyta
Thallophyta
Bryophyta
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Bryophyta

Explanation:
Bryophytes are called the 'Amphibians of Plant Kingdom' because they can survive in both aquatic and terrestrial environments but require water for reproduction. They lack true roots and instead have rhizoids that anchor them to the surface. Bryophytes include mosses, liverworts, and hornworts. These plants are found in moist habitats and their life cycle cannot be completed without water. They represent the simplest land plants and lack vascular tissues.

Extra Facts:
Bryophytes play a crucial role in ecosystems by contributing to soil formation and water retention. Their life cycle alternates between two phases: the dominant gametophyte and the sporophyte. Bryophytes are also used as bioindicators of air pollution. They were the first plants to colonize land and act as pioneer species in ecological succession. Their reproduction depends on water for sperm motility.

Plants that do not have well-differentiated body design fall in this group. The plants in this group are commonly called algae. This group is ______.

[SSC GD 2022]
options: Gymnosperms
Pteridophytes
Thallophytes
Bryophytes
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Thallophytes

Explanation:
Thallophytes are a group of plants that lack a well-differentiated body structure. They do not have distinct roots, stems, or leaves. Instead, their body is a simple 'thallus' without specialized tissues. Algae are a prime example of this group. Thallophytes lack vascular tissues (xylem and phloem), which is why they are mostly found in moist and small habitats. Reproduction in thallophytes primarily occurs through spores.

Extra Facts:
Thallophytes are also called 'lower plants' because they represent an early stage in plant evolution. They contain chlorophyll, enabling them to perform photosynthesis. Some thallophytes, like lichens, are symbiotic associations of algae and fungi. These organisms are ecologically significant as they contribute to oxygen production and form part of aquatic ecosystems.

थैलोफाइट्स वे पौधे होते हैं जिनमें अच्छी तरह से विभेदित शरीर संरचना नहीं होती है। इनमें जड़, तना और पत्तियों का स्पष्ट विभाजन नहीं होता। इनका शरीर एक सरल 'थैलस' (Thallus) के रूप में होता है, जिसमें कोई विशेषीकृत ऊतक नहीं होते। शैवाल (Algae) इस समूह का एक प्रमुख उदाहरण है। थैलोफाइट्स में संवहनी ऊतक (vascular tissues) का अभाव होता है, जिसके कारण ये छोटे और नम स्थानों में पाए जाते हैं। इनमें प्रजनन मुख्यतः बीजाणुओं (spores) द्वारा होता है।

Extra Facts:
थैलोफाइट्स को 'निम्न श्रेणी के पौधे' (Lower Plants) भी कहा जाता है क्योंकि ये पौधों के विकास की प्रारंभिक अवस्था को दर्शाते हैं। इनमें क्लोरोफिल होता है, जिसके कारण ये प्रकाश संश्लेषण (Photosynthesis) कर सकते हैं। कुछ थैलोफाइट्स, जैसे लाइकेन (Lichens), शैवाल और कवक (Fungi) के सहजीवी संबंध से बनते हैं। ये पर्यावरण के लिए महत्वपूर्ण हैं क्योंकि ये ऑक्सीजन उत्पादन में योगदान देते हैं और जलीय पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Aquatic Ecosystem) का हिस्सा होते हैं।

question:
Which of the following is NOT a vertebrate class?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Cyclostomata
Annelida
Pisces
Reptilia
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Annelida

Explanation:
Annelida is an invertebrate phylum, whereas Cyclostomata, Pisces, and Reptilia are vertebrate classes. Vertebrates are characterized by the presence of a vertebral column (backbone), which is absent in invertebrates. Annelids include organisms like earthworms and leeches, which lack a backbone. Cyclostomata (e.g., hagfish and lampreys), Pisces (fishes), and Reptilia (snakes, lizards) are all vertebrates.

Extra Facts:
Vertebrates are divided into five main classes: Pisces (fishes), Amphibia (amphibians), Reptilia (reptiles), Aves (birds), and Mammalia (mammals). Cyclostomata are sometimes classified as vertebrates due to the presence of primitive vertebral structures. Annelids have segmented bodies and possess a true excretory system (nephridia). They play a crucial role in soil fertility through their burrowing activities.

question:
Which of the following is the study of insects and their relationship to humans , the environment, and other organisms?

[SSC CGL 2021]
options: Ornithology
Entomology
Ethology
Mycology
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Entomology

Explanation:
Entomology is the branch of biology that studies insects and their relationships with humans, the environment, and other organisms. Insects are the most diverse and abundant group of organisms on Earth, with over 1 million identified species. Entomology covers the study of insect anatomy, behavior, ecology, evolution, and the diseases they spread. This field is crucial in agriculture, medicine, and environmental conservation, as insects play significant roles in pollination, pest control, and disease transmission.

Extra Facts:
Entomology includes specialized fields like apiculture (beekeeping) and sericulture (silkworm cultivation). It also plays a key role in biological control, where beneficial insects are used to manage pest populations. The study of disease vectors like mosquitoes (which spread malaria and dengue) falls under entomology. Insects are also vital indicators of environmental health and biodiversity.

question:
The system of scientific naming Organism was introduced by:

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Carolus Linnaeus
George Caley
Alexis Carrel
Angel Cabrera
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Carolus Linnaeus

Explanation:
The binomial nomenclature system of scientific naming was introduced by Carolus Linnaeus in 1753 in his book 'Species Plantarum'. According to this system, each organism's name consists of two parts - the first is the genus and the second is the species. For example, the scientific name of humans is Homo sapiens. This system simplifies the classification and study of organisms and brings uniformity at the global level.

Extra Facts:
Carolus Linnaeus is called the 'Father of Taxonomy'. He classified organisms into five groups - Kingdom, Class, Order, Genus, and Species. His system revolutionized biology and is still used today. Linnaeus applied this system to both plants and animals.

Extra Facts:

question:
Plants are divided into ﬁve groups. Which of the following is NOT one?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Bryophytes
Gymnosperms
Pteridophytes
Protochordata
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Protochordata

Explanation:
Plants are classified into five major groups: Thallophyta, Bryophyta, Pteridophyta, Gymnosperms, and Angiosperms. Bryophytes (e.g., mosses), Pteridophytes (e.g., ferns), and Gymnosperms (e.g., pines) are plant groups. Protochordata is an animal group, including Urochordata and Cephalochordata. It is not a plant group, hence the correct answer.

Extra Facts:
Thallophyta includes algae and lichens, which lack roots, stems, and leaves. Bryophyta are the simplest land plants without vascular tissues. Pteridophyta have vascular tissues but do not produce seeds. Gymnosperms are naked-seeded plants, while Angiosperms are flowering and fruit-bearing plants.

question:
What is the generic name given to members of the cat family?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Feline
Caprine
Canine
Bovine
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Feline

Explanation:
Members of the cat family are classified under the generic name 'Feline', derived from the Latin word 'Felis', meaning 'cat'. In biology, the Felidae family includes all cat species, such as domestic cats, lions, tigers, leopards, etc. These are carnivorous animals with physical adaptations like sharp claws, strong jaws, and excellent vision for hunting. The term 'Feline' is used to describe their shared characteristics, such as retractable claws (except cheetahs) and nocturnal habits.

Extra Facts:
The Felidae family is divided into two subfamilies: Pantherinae (big cats like lions and tigers) and Felinae (small cats like domestic cats). Felines are known for their hunting technique of suffocating prey by biting the neck. Their eyes contain a reflective layer called the 'tapetum lucidum', enhancing night vision. The domestic cat's scientific name is Felis catus, while the lion is Panthera leo.

हल: सही उत्तर है फेलाइन

Explanation:
बिल्ली प्रजाति के सदस्यों को वर्गीकरण (Taxonomy) में 'फेलाइन' (Feline) नाम से जाना जाता है। यह शब्द लैटिन शब्द 'Felis' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'बिल्ली'। जीव विज्ञान में, 'फेलिडे' (Felidae) परिवार में सभी बिल्ली प्रजातियाँ शामिल हैं, जैसे कि घरेलू बिल्ली, शेर, बाघ, तेंदुआ आदि। ये सभी मांसाहारी (Carnivorous) होते हैं और इनकी शारीरिक संरचना शिकार करने के लिए अनुकूलित होती है, जैसे कि तेज पंजे, मजबूत जबड़े और उत्कृष्ट दृष्टि।

Extra Facts:
फेलिडे परिवार को दो उपपरिवारों में विभाजित किया गया है: पैंथरिनी (बड़ी बिल्लियाँ, जैसे शेर, बाघ) और फेलिनी (छोटी बिल्लियाँ, जैसे घरेलू बिल्ली)। बिल्लियों की प्रजातियाँ अपने शिकार को दबोचने और गर्दन तोड़ने की तकनीक के लिए जानी जाती हैं। इनकी आँखों में 'टेपेटम ल्यूसिडम' नामक परत होती है, जो रात में देखने की क्षमता को बढ़ाती है।

question:
Identify the largest phylum in the animal kingdom.

[SSC CPO 2024]
options: Mollusca
Annelida
Arthropoda
Platyhelmenthis
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Arthropoda

Explanation:
The largest phylum in the animal kingdom is Arthropoda. This phylum is the largest both in terms of diversity and number of species. Arthropoda includes insects, spiders, prawns, crabs, etc. Their characteristics include: segmented body, jointed appendages, exoskeleton made of chitin. This phylum constitutes about 80% of all known animal species on Earth. Its vast number and diversity make it the largest phylum in the animal kingdom.

Extra Facts:
The Arthropoda phylum is divided into four major classes: Insecta (insects), Arachnida (spiders), Crustacea (prawns), Myriapoda (millipedes). These organisms are found in all types of environments - water, land, and air. Their exoskeleton not only provides protection but also prevents water loss. Arthropods play a crucial role in ecosystems, such as pollination, decomposition, etc.

question_hi:
प्राणि जगत के सबसे बड़े संघ की पहचान कीजिए।

[SSC CPO 2024]
options_hi: मोलस्का
एनीलिडा
आर्थोपोडा
प्लेटीहेल्मिन्थीज़
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है आर्थोपोडा

Explanation:
प्राणि जगत का सबसे बड़ा संघ आर्थोपोडा है। यह संघ जीवों की विविधता और संख्या दोनों में सबसे बड़ा है। आर्थोपोडा संघ में कीट, मकड़ी, झींगा, केकड़ा आदि शामिल हैं। इनकी विशेषताएं हैं: खंडित शरीर, संधियुक्त उपांग, काइटिन से बना बाह्य कंकाल। यह संघ पृथ्वी पर सभी जीवों का लगभग 80% हिस्सा है। इसकी विशाल संख्या और विविधता इसे प्राणि जगत का सबसे बड़ा संघ बनाती है।

Extra Facts:
आर्थोपोडा संघ को चार प्रमुख वर्गों में बांटा गया है: इन्सेक्टा (कीट), अरक्निडा (मकड़ी), क्रस्टेशिया (झींगा), मिरियापोडा (कनखजूरा)। ये जीव सभी प्रकार के वातावरण में पाए जाते हैं - जल, थल और वायु में। इनका बाह्य कंकाल न केवल सुरक्षा प्रदान करता है बल्कि जल की हानि को भी रोकता है। आर्थोपोडा संघ के जीव पारिस्थितिक तंत्र में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाते हैं, जैसे परागण, अपघटन आदि।
